curated.category: 罕见自身免疫性大疱性皮肤病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 体内产生抗桥粒芯蛋白（Dsg3/Dsg1）自身抗体，导致皮肤和口腔黏膜表皮细胞间粘附松解、出现大面积松弛性水疱与糜烂；糖皮质激素问世前病死率高达70%–90%，现代治疗下仍需高度警惕广泛皮损继发金葡菌/铜绿假单胞菌败血症、低蛋白电解质紊乱及大剂量激素感染并发症（病死率约5%–10%）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 已从高致死性皮肤病转变为可高度缓解的疾病：利妥昔单抗（抗CD20单抗）联合短期系统性糖皮质激素现已成为国际与中国指南一线金标准，可使约70%–90%患者达到长期完全缓解并大幅减少激素副作用。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet未单列全球年死亡人数，现代规范免疫治疗下5年病死率已降至约5%–10%（感染为主因）

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球总患病率约1–5/10,000，年发病率约0.1–0.5/10万（Orphanet ORPHA:704）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: PV是中国最常见的天疱疮亚型（占天疱疮病例约49%–55%），好发于30–60岁中青年与中年人，常以顽固性口腔溃疡为首发易被误诊

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 大面积糜烂与败血症急症处置：1) 若口腔咽喉严重糜烂无法进食、全身大面积水疱破溃渗液伴高热寒战，立即急诊住院隔离护理；2) 静脉补充白蛋白、电解质与营养，创面行无菌油纱保护与细菌培养，针对性抗感染；3) 急诊不可擅自骤停原有激素（防肾上腺危象）。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 中国多中心真实世界大样本研究证实利妥昔单抗联合激素在52周可使近半数以上患者实现极低激素剂量下的完全缓解；2) 靶向FcRn的艾加莫德曾在3期ADDRESS试验中未能达到主要终点并终止天疱疮开发，促使研发转向更具选择性的BTK抑制剂（Rilzabrutinib）及靶向清除抗Dsg3特异性B细胞的CAAR-T细胞疗法（DSG3-CAART）1期临床探索。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 患者从出现口腔溃疡到最终确诊往往延误数月；2) 利妥昔单抗与大剂量激素仍伴随肺部感染、乙肝激活等全身免疫抑制风险，亟需仅清除致病抗Dsg B细胞的CAAR-T等精准免疫疗法；3) 超低剂量利妥昔单抗在中国人群中的最佳维持方案尚待大型随机试验统一。

master.definition_en: Pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis is a disorder in which tiny fragments (microliths) of calcium phosphate gradually accumulate in the small air sacs (alveoli) of the lungs. These deposits eventually cause widespread damage to the alveoli and surrounding lung tissue (interstitial lung disease). People with this disorder may also develop a persistent cough and difficulty breathing (dyspnea), especially during physical exertion. Chest pain that worsens when coughing, sneezing, or taking deep breaths is another common feature. People with pulmonary alveolar microlithiasismay also develop calcium phosphate deposits in other organs and tissue of the body. Though the course of the disease can be variable,many casesslowly progress to lung fibrosis, respiratory failure, or cor pulmonale. The only effective therapy is lung transplantation. In some cases, pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis is caused by mutations in the SLC34A2 gene and inherited in an autosomal recessive manner.

master.name_en: acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy
master.definition_en: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy (APMPPE) is an acquired, inflammatory eye condition affecting the retina, retinal pigment epithelium (pigmented layer of the retina), and choroid. It usually affects both eyes and is characterized by multiple, yellow-white lesions in the back of the eye. The condition can significantly impair visual acuity if the macula is involved. APMPPE typically resolves on its own in weeks to months. While the cause is unknown, about a third of cases appear to develop after a flu-like illness. Non-ocular symptoms are uncommon, but cerebral vasculitis can be present and may cause permanent and/or severe neurological complications.
